incident-bot: PagerDuty: ALERT fired for tenant="synthesis" pool="reserved-pool-23" metric=p95_latency value=1.82s threshold=1.5s window=10m link=https://pagerduty.example/INC-98321 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Incident INC-98321 created and notifying eng-oncall. Escalation policy: reserved-capacity-oncall.
alex (oncall): on it. acked PD. I'm jumping in — starting with metrics and autoscaler status.
marta (sre): I can see the p95 spike correlated w/ a burst from embeddings-worker-7. KV hit ratio dropped, eviction rate spiked.
jamie (eng-runtime): FYI there's a recent config change on reserved-pool-23 yesterday that lowered kv_cache_target from 4GB -> 2GB for GC tuning. Could be related.
alex (oncall): good catch. paging runtime team. @jamie can you check node-level memory + OOM logs?
jamie (eng-runtime): looking now. logs show repeated `kvcache_evict()` in a tight loop. sample: ```
[2026-03-15T09:02:12Z] eviction count=128 node=g2-23 kv_free=120MB threshold=200MB
[2026-03-15T09:02:13Z] eviction count=200 node=g2-23 alloc_fail latency=1200ms
[2026-03-15T09:02:14Z] request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate tenant=synthesis tokens=512
```
alex (oncall): looks like requests driving large context lengths. Any sudden customer rollout? @tess can you check customer-side activity?
tess (customer-success): pinged synthesis CSM. They report a new batch embedding job kicked off around 08:50 UTC causing many parallel long-context requests. They're investigating whether it was accidental.
pd-ops: PD note: INC-98321 auto-escalated to senior-oncall at +7m, ack sequence shows alex ack at 09:03.
marta (sre): mitigation options: 1) increase kv_cache_target back to 4GB (quick config flip + rolling restart), 2) enable temporary throttling for tenant synthesis (soft-limit route), 3) route overflow to hosted pool fallback.
alex (oncall): short-term: enable tenant soft-throttle to cap concurrent inferences to 25, route overflow to hosted fallback, and lift kv cache target to 3.5GB then monitor. Jamies, can you do the kv change?
jamie (eng-runtime): I'll bump kv_cache_target to 3.5GB on reserved-pool-23 and trigger a controlled rolling restart for the pool. Command: ```
runbook apply-config --pool reserved-pool-23 --set kv_cache_target=3.5GB --rolling-restart
``` ETA ~3-4 minutes.
jamie (eng-runtime): started rolling restart. watching gauge: kv_free is climbing back up.
marta (sre): initiating tenant soft-throttle: ```
routectl throttle --tenant synthesis --concurrency 25 --mode soft --expire 30m
```
alex (oncall): throttle applied. monitoring latency and errors.
tess (customer-success): synthesis CSM confirms they paused the batch job after we asked. thanking ops.
marta (sre): p95 trending down: 1.82 -> 0.98 -> 0.64 over last 8m. eviction count dropping.
PagerDuty: Reminder: keep incident INC-98321 open until root cause + mitigation confirmed.
alex (oncall): I'll keep it open. Next steps: follow up with synthesis on batching pattern, recommend rate-limiting on their side and adaptive batching; jamie to propose a safe kv_cache_target guard in config. Marta to write short post-incident note w/ metrics.
jamie (eng-runtime): opening a config PR to prevent kv_cache_target below 3GB for reserved pools serving embeddings-heavy tenants. link: https://git.example/r/PR-4721
marta (sre): tentative RCA: combined factors: customer batch job causing sustained large contexts + recent kv cache reduction -> eviction storm -> request latency spike. Not a runaway QoS issue in infra, mitigated by throttle + restart.
alex (oncall): handing off to next oncall (node rotation) @marta you own until incident closed, I'll update PD with summary. next oncall ping @ryan.
pd-ops: INC-98321: ack sequence and timeline recorded. escalation history attached to PD incident.
tess (customer-success): synthesis says they'll implement client-side backoff and lower concurrency. they asked for a post-incident call — scheduling.
marta (sre): closing steps: monitor 30m window, verify eviction stays low, mark incident as resolved in PD once window passes.
alex (oncall): thanks team. adding notes to runbook and incident doc. :white_check_mark:
[morning-ops-bot] automatic followup scheduled in 24h to check config PR and customer changes.
